items.name: narration_en
items.direction: Narrate this as a popular geography YouTube Shorts channel. The Narrator is a deep, warm, confident storyteller, brisk and curious, with natural emphasis and a short comic pause before each punchline. IMPORTANT: keep the SAME loudness, energy and distance from the microphone from the first line to the last; do not get quieter or softer towards the end.
lines: Narrator
What if I told you... one Russian region is bigger than Argentina?
Narrator
That's fact one... of five Russia facts that sound fake.
Narrator
Yakutia covers about three point one million square kilometres. Argentina? Two point eight million.
Narrator
And fewer than a million people... live there.
Narrator
Two: one Russian lake holds more water... than all five Great Lakes combined.
Narrator
Lake Baikal. Over one point six kilometres deep, and at least twenty-five million years old.
Narrator
Three: one train ride... crosses eight time zones.
Narrator
The Trans-Siberian. Nine thousand, two hundred and eighty-nine kilometres, Moscow to Vladivostok, about six days.
Narrator
You'd change your watch... more often than your socks.
Narrator
Four: Russian astronauts... don't launch from Russia.
Narrator
They fly from Baikonur, in Kazakhstan. Russia rents it... until twenty fifty.
Narrator
About one hundred and fifteen million dollars a year... Some rent.
Narrator
Five: people live in a village... that hit minus sixty-seven point seven degrees.
Narrator
Oy-myah-KON. Even an average January day is about minus forty-six.
Narrator
And school? It only closes... below minus fifty-five.
Narrator
So... which one sounded the most fake?
Narrator
This is Bhoogol. Follow for more Geography Fun Facts.
